about: Acceptance-side record identity for the table-row events of the two renewal samples, read only by scripts/renewal-triage.py (--identity); the product never reads it.

Each pair is bound to its unchanged author changes.json by SHA-256. Each table lists its author events by id and the author-row cells (0-based, in the author's ' | ' order) that hold the record's identifier, with the printed column heading or layout that shows it.
A table with an empty identity list is declared without identity: its row events are not evaluated for attribution. An event in no table has no declared identity either.
Headings were read from the PDFs (MuPDF extraction, left and right); block ids and 'the first name-like cell' are not used.

tables.basis: No printed column heading. Each clause line on page 5 starts with its form reference (AVN52E, AVN111, ...) in its own column at x about 66 pt, the title in the next column at x about 166 pt; the author rows give the reference as their first cell.

tables.heading: Insurer | Reference | Written Line | Stamp Date
tables.basis: Printed heading 'Insurer' over the first column.

tables.heading: Aircraft Type | MSN | Registration | Year | Seats | Agreed Value Lessee / Operator (USD)
tables.basis: Printed headings 'MSN' and 'Registration' over the second and third columns.

tables.heading: Engine Type | ESN | Location | Agreed Value Status (USD)
tables.basis: Printed heading 'ESN' over the second column.

tables.heading: MSN | Contract Party | Capacity | Endorsement
tables.basis: Printed headings 'MSN' and 'Contract Party'. A row names one party of one aircraft, and an aircraft can have several parties, so the record is the MSN with its contract party.
No printed column heading; the first column is an item number (1.1, 1.3, ...), not an identifier. Not evaluated for attribution.

No printed column heading. Each clause line on page 5 starts with its form reference (LSW617H, AVN111, ...) in its own column at x about 219 pt, the title in the next column at x about 291 pt; the author rows give the reference as their first cell.

tables.heading: (Re)insurer | Written Line | Reference
tables.basis: Printed heading '(Re)insurer' over the first column.

tables.heading: Code | Description | Allocation
tables.basis: Printed heading 'Code' over the first column.

tables.heading: Aircraft Type | Serial No. | Registration Year | Seats | Agreed Value Liability CSL (USD)
tables.basis: Printed headings 'Serial No.' and 'Registration' (printed as 'Registration Year' over the registration and year columns) over the second and third author cells.

tables.heading: Registration | Hull Rate | Hull (USD) | Liability (USD) | Hull War (USD) | Total (USD)
tables.basis: Printed heading 'Registration' over the first column.

tables.heading: Registration | Contract Party | Capacity | Endorsement
tables.basis: Printed headings 'Registration' and 'Contract Party'. A registration has several parties (M-FNKA, M-FNKB and M-CHLS each appear twice on the left), so the record is the registration with its contract party.

tables.heading: Base | Hangar Operator | Aircraft Normally Based | Hangar Type
tables.basis: Printed heading 'Base' over the first column; one row per base.
